geometry_edits.rationale: Wrap the dominant mass with a carve_void modifier so the next version has a ground-level public void without discarding the existing anchor.
Open the carve toward the verified access side in the program frame.
Keep the void proportionally clear and spatially usable.

graph_edits.rationale: Add a void-making operation to convert the sealed dominant mass into a building with a readable public ground response at the access edge while preserving the main massing gesture.
Align the public carve to the access side specified by the program context so the street threshold becomes legible.
Use a moderate carve to create usable public space rather than a decorative notch.

rationale: The candidate is a coherent single mass in all views, so it avoids fragmentation and view-to-view collision, but it reads as a generic compact object with a stepped/channeled envelope rather than a neighborhood living building with an active street threshold. The parcel is contained, yet the dominant gesture mostly fills the envelope instead of forming a clear public void or entry seam tied to the access edge. Because the program contract calls for a compact capacity-aware street building with one clear public void/terrace and active ground edge, the visible mass does not yet support the required semantic relationship; it is closer to an abstract sculpted block than a mixed-use neighborhood building. The section also does not express daylight, terrace, or ground-related occupation strongly enough to satisfy program fit.

reference_assessments.mismatch_warning: The candidate is much lower and more object-like; it lacks the tower-scaled sectional ambition and layered public base seen here.
reference_assessments.transferable_principle: A compact mixed-use mass can gain civic clarity through a stepped/tapered upper figure while keeping a grounded, legible base.

reference_assessments.mismatch_warning: This precedent is tower-based and not directly transferable to the candidate’s low slab-like typology without losing program fit.
reference_assessments.transferable_principle: A continuous vertical mass can be subtly torqued or tapered to keep one dominant volume while varying the skyline.

reference_assessments.mismatch_warning: The candidate currently seals the ground plane more than this reference and does not establish a comparable public threshold.
reference_assessments.transferable_principle: A neighborhood commercial building can read clearly when the ground edge is open and the upper mass remains calm and compact.
